title: git checkout -B _autogen_sync_ fails with uncommitted changes in commit-step workflows

root_cause.mechanism: Commit-step workflows generate local file changes, copy them to /tmp, then try to checkout the target branch. Git refuses because uncommitted changes would be overwritten.
root_cause.trigger_condition: Workflow generates new content in-place before the branch switch. Files are safe in /tmp, so force-checkout is correct.
root_cause.error_message: error: Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by checkout

fix.command: git checkout -fB _autogen_sync_ origin/"$_TARGET"  # -f = force, safe because files already copied to /tmp

prevention: Whenever a commit-step workflow copies files to /tmp before switching branches, add -f to git checkout to allow the switch. Document the -f with a comment explaining why it is safe.
